_comment: Cell descriptor for layout/bin/compose-cell.py -- see layout/README.md
for the recipe this follows (ported from 2AMLogic/sky130-trng) and
issue #30 for why this is a standalone proof cell rather than the full
design/bias_core.sch composition.
This is design/netlist/bias_core.spice's XQ8A..XQ8H group: 8 unit
sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40 devices, each called 'VSS VSS EC'
(collector=VSS, base=VSS, emitter=EC) -- design/bias_core.md's sizing
section calls this the '8:1 PNP emitter-count ratio' leg (the matching
1x reference unit, XQ1, and the VREF-leg unit, XQR, are each a separate
single-instance device elsewhere in bias_core and are NOT part of this
proof cell).
klt gen bjt_array (rows=2, cols=4, ratio=8, common_centroid, a shared
collector guard ring) draws the whole matched-common-centroid array in
ONE call -- no manual multi-block placement is needed the way
sky130-trng's ro_stage/ro_nand2 gates need it, since bjt_array already
IS the composed common-centroid unit.
KNOWN GAP, reported upstream generically as 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#TODO
(see layout/README.md 'Known klt gaps hit building this recipe' for the
full writeup): the collector guard ring (bjt_array's COLL_N/S/E/W
ports, drawn on the diffusion role, not li1) is deliberately left OUT
of this cell.json's own connectivity[] and is NOT part of the 'vss'
net below. `klt gen-compose` reports a routed:true leg and a clean
`klt drc` for a COLL_* pin wired into a connectivity[] net at every
layer_role tried, but never actually draws the licon/mcon contact onto
the diffusion port -- `klt extract` always recovers the collector as a
separate, unstrapped 'vsubs' node (confirmed common across all 8 units,
i.e. the guard ring's own diffusion is correctly extracted as ONE
shared physical node -- it is only the strap to VSS that is missing).
Worse, attempting it *alongside* a second same-block net (this cell's
own 'ec') was observed to corrupt that second net's own extraction --
'ec' and 'vss' merged into one shorted node -- even though `klt drc`
still reported clean and every leg still reported routed:true. Dropping
COLL_* from connectivity[] avoids both failure modes and leaves 'vss'
(8 base pins) / 'ec' (8 emitter pins) DRC-clean, correctly separate,
and individually LVS-matchable against the design's own device cards
-- only the collector-to-VSS strap this proof cell's own LVS run
against the *unmodified* design/netlist/bias_core.spice reference
still (honestly) reports as a mismatch. Revisit once the upstream gap
is fixed.
Routing: base 'metal' role (li1) with 'cross_block_layer_role: metal2'
(met1) for the two same-block self-nets ('vss' bussing 8 base pins,
'ec' bussing 8 emitter pins, each crossing the other's intervening
pads) -- this is docs/cli/gen-compose.md's own 'Cross-block bus
routing (routing.cross_block_layer_role, #1168)' worked example,
reproduced almost verbatim against this same 8-unit bjt_array shape.
